_comment: Copy to .test-cluster.json (gitignored) and set remoteHost. See scripts/testCluster.sh.
_capacities: Relative throughput. Left at 1/1 the work splits evenly; the runner re-measures and rewrites these after each run when autotune is on. A 16GB machine typically earns well above 1 against an 8GB one, because this suite is limited by memory and thermals rather than cores.
_workers: Empty means the cap vite.config.ts works out for the machine, which is the lower of half the cores and what its RAM can hold (WORKER_PEAK_GB/HOST_RESERVE_GB there) -- normally leave it empty. Since the 626-club world a worker on a heavy sim file peaks at 2-3GB and keeps it, so 8GB earns 1 worker and 16GB earns 4; setting a number here passes --maxWorkers and OVERRIDES that memory cap, so only do it to go lower.
